title: Selective Service registration - basics
facts: Federal law generally requires male U.S. citizens and male immigrants residing in the United States to register with Selective Service within the applicable age window, with statutory exceptions.
Registration generally applies from age 18 through age 25; a person cannot register after turning 26.
Immigration status and other circumstances can affect whether registration was required, so individual eligibility should be checked against Selective Service rules.
Registration is not the same as being drafted into the military.
